subject: MPA kickoff: phased evidence windows + MSA/DPA/order form sequencing
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightline.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: alan.chu@brightline.com
Date: 2026-05-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: phased evidence windows + MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Alan and I sketched an internal plan and want to align on a mutual action plan that sequences the MSA, DPA and order form so we can hit our July pilot start. High level asks from procurement/legal:

- We need a phased evidence window (SOC2 + dataflow diagrams) delivered in two tranches to satisfy our security review by mid-June and final acceptance by end of June.
- Can Redwood sign the standard DPA in parallel to MSA redlines, or do you require the MSA final first?
- DocuSign ordering: procurement wants the order form routed to our billing contact only after legal signs both MSA+DPA. Is there flexibility on conditional order execution?

Attaching a quick evidence matrix and our intake template. Would you and your legal lead be available for a 30m alignment tomorrow?

Best,
Sophie Turner
Sr. Procurement Manager
Brightline Health

Attachments: evidence-matrix_v1.pdf, intake-template.xlsx

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightline.com>, Alan Chu <alan.chu@brightline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: phased evidence windows + MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Sophie — thanks for the clear asks and the matrix.

Short answers:
- We can do a two-tranche evidence delivery (initial artifacts + dataflow diagrams by 6/14, remaining evidence and penetration test summary by 6/28).
- Redwood legal prefers executing a DPA in tandem with negotiated MSA redlines; we can present a paired MSA+DPA package for your counsel to review to speed things up.
- Conditional order execution is possible: we typically accept DocuSign orders with a clause that final billing activation follows completion of acceptance evidence. We can draft language to satisfy your procurement team.

Next steps: I’ve added Karthik (legal) and Marissa (CS operations) to this thread to propose an MPA draft and sequencing. Karthik — can your team review existing redlines and suggest a paired timeline by EOD 6/1? Marissa — can you outline the billing activation trigger we use for pilots?

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightline_MAP_v1.xlsx (initial draft)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightline.com>, Alan Chu <alan.chu@brightline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: phased evidence windows + MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Laura / Sophie —

I reviewed the redlines Laura shared. Summary and recommended sequencing below:

1) Immediate (6/1–6/7): Share final DPA draft with your counsel (we'll lock data processing terms and subprocessor list). This is low-risk and unblocks security review.

2) Parallel (6/8–6/18): MSA commercial redlines — we suggest an expedited 10-business-day review window. I'll provide annotated comments in the attached redlines document.

3) Evidence tranche 1 (deliver by 6/14): dataflow diagrams, network segmentation summary, and SOC2 scoping note.

4) Evidence tranche 2 (deliver by 6/28): pen-test summary (redacted), retention matrix, and audit-log examples.

5) Order form routing: propose DocuSign flow A — DPA + MSA countersigned by legal -> then order form routed to procurement + billing for execution; however, for pilot activation we can accept a provisional order signed by procurement with an explicit activation clause tied to evidence tranche 2.

Risks & mitigations: if MSA redlines extend beyond 6/18, we fall back to a temporary pilots addendum (30-day) to allow pilot start while legal completes MSA. We'll flag any material deviations.

I will upload the annotated redlines and a proposed MPA timeline shortly.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_MSA_vLAURA_20260531.docx

From: Alan Chu <alan.chu@brightline.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightline.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: phased evidence windows + MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Karthik — appreciate the granular timeline. A couple quick clarifications from procurement:

- Can you commit to the DPA review window 6/1–6/7? Our legal team has limited capacity and needs a committed turnaround to schedule their review.
- If we accept a provisional pilot addendum, can you confirm the maximum pilot spend cap and a rollback plan if final MSA terms are not agreed?

If you can confirm those two items we can lock the internal calendar and budget owner approvals.

Thanks,
Alan
Director, Procurement
Brightline Health

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Alan Chu <alan.chu@brightline.com>, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: phased evidence windows + MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Alan / Sophie —

Confirming: Redwood can commit to the DPA review window 6/1–6/7. Karthik will push the DPA package to your counsel this morning.

Provisional pilot addendum: yes — we can accept a 30-day provisional addendum with a pilot spend cap of $12,500. If final MSA terms are not agreed at the end of the addendum, we will:

- Pause billing activation and suspend pilot access within 72 hours of notice, and
- Provide data export and a 14-day transitional support window.

Marissa, please prepare the addendum template and map the DocuSign routing (DPA+MSA -> procurement -> billing) and share the link to the envelope when ready.

Laura
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightline_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with spend cap line), https://docusign.com/envelopes/ABC123456789
